items.title: Labcorp (LH) Launches Marker Genetic Health Panel For Consumer Testing

The product brings together genetic testing, counseling, and biomarker analysis in one offering for individuals looking to better understand their health risks. The launch uses Labcorp’s existing testing infrastructure alongside new AI-powered platforms to support more tailored insights for consumers.
